name: paymydine-cashier-desktop
description: PayMyDine universal cashier desktop app with branded hardware setup, truthful hardware diagnostics, fullscreen cashier, direct receipt/invoice print routing, physical printer/cash drawer support and Virtual PDF debugging

scripts.dev: npm run patch:v108 && npm run brand:icon && electron .

scripts.check: npm run patch:v108 && node --check scripts/patch-chain-v106.js && node --check scripts/apply-v108.js && node --check scripts/fetch-brand-icon.js && node --check scripts/apply-v106.js && node --check scripts/after-sign-mac-v106.js && node --check src/main.js && node --check src/preload.js && node --check src/setup.js && node --check src/hardware.js && node --check src/receipt.js && node --check src/hardware-page.js && node --check src/offline.js
scripts.dist:win: npm run patch:v108 && npm run brand:icon && electron-builder --win nsis
scripts.dist:mac: npm run patch:v108 && npm run brand:icon && electron-builder --mac dmg zip
